assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation, non-testing task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates doc-only scope) and testing tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates cross-cutting testing scope) are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 1-4 (task-1-severity-aggregation-service.md, task-2-advisory-summary-endpoint.md, task-3-cache-invalidation-on-ingestion.md, task-4-severity-threshold-filter.md) each contain ## Repository, ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Files to Modify (tasks 1, 2 also ## Files to Create), ## Implementation Notes, ## Acceptance Criteria, ## Test Requirements. Doc task 5 and testing tasks 6, 7 contain Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements.

assertion_results.text: Task count is between 3 and 12 inclusive
assertion_results.evidence: 7 task files (task-1 through task-7); the impact map Tasks table lists 7 rows.

assertion_results.text: Task dependencies form a DAG with no circular dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1: None; Task 2 -> 1; Task 3 -> 2; Task 4 -> 2; Tasks 5, 6, 7 -> 1, 2, 3, 4. No cycles. The impact map Links section also states 'DAG, no cycles'.

assertion_results.evidence: Every modified path exists in the manifest: modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/mod.rs, sbom/service/sbom.rs, sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs, graph/sbom/mod.rs, ingestor/src/service/mod.rs, server/src/main.rs, tests/api/sbom.rs, tests/api/advisory.rs. assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md changes name exact files and behaviors, e.g. 'Add SbomService::advisory_severity_summary in modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/sbom.rs: single GROUP BY severity query over entity sbom_advisory ⨝ advisory with COUNT(DISTINCT advisory.id)' and 'register GET /api/v2/sbom/{id}/advisory-summary in sbom/endpoints/mod.rs with 404 for unknown SBOM'.

assertion_results.evidence: Each of the 7 task files has a Repository section containing only 'trustify-backend'.

assertion_results.evidence: All 7 task files contain ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Acceptance Criteria, and ## Test Requirements.

assertion_results.evidence: All 7 task files have '## Target Branch\nmain'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-digest.md through task-7-digest.md each hold '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<hex>'. All 7 hashes were checked as 64 lowercase hex characters, e.g. task-1: sha256-md:cfdc993f8035fc4441e0a4ded37f14a4bb8ef67c7cf7024188e5db77e5c221f5. The same hashes are in the impact map Tasks table.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Every 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §...' line has a rationale in the prescribed format, e.g. task-1: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/sbom.rs` matching the convention's domain module (`modules/*/src/**/*.rs`) scope.' and task-2: 'Applies: task creates `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/advisory_summary.rs` matching the convention's Rust handler (`.rs`) scope.' A grep for 'Not applicable' and 'N/A' found nothing in the outputs. Conventions are applied selectively per task, e.g. Caching appears only in task 2.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The feature priority is Major. The impact-map.md Task Creation Log shows additional_fields '"priority": {"name": "Major"}' and states '**priority**: Feature priority is `Major` (not "Undefined") → propagated.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]' and states '**fixVersions**: Feature has `RHTPA 1.5.0`, and CLAUDE.md `fixVersion scope: both` → propagated to tasks.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: There is no summary-comment.md. However, impact-map.md has a section '## additional_fields applied to every created issue (Epics and Tasks)' listing priority Major and fixVersions RHTPA 1.5.0 with propagation reasons. The Feature inputs table also says 'Major (set — will be inherited)' and 'RHTPA 1.5.0 (non-empty — will be inherited)'.
